name: alpha_boundary
description: Broad general sweep — WARM-START version (the corrected default). Same grid as the frozen alpha_boundary_scratch, but every retrain continues the initial model's weights on the new points (warm_start=true) instead of training from scratch, so the global-MAE regression from catastrophic forgetting is largely removed. Writes to its own fresh file sweep__alpha_boundary.csv; the scratch reference is left untouched for a scratch-vs-warm comparison. Probes the rehearsal-mix alpha x gap-size (radius) boundary with the selection and retraining axes; initial-training time iters_initial [10,20,50,100,200] is widened to bracket the ~50 whole-area sweet spot (where the initial model is undertrained enough for a real weakspot, so guided can win over the whole area, not just in the gap). mix_ratio spans 0.0-1.0 (incl. the more-rehearsal whole-area sweet spot). Trimmed the dominated / over-training values (n_train 2500, n_select 50, radius 0.08, iters_retrain 300) to slim runtime. Top-5 detectors. ~324,000 configs (~3-4 h on 60+ vCores).
